Earnings Prep Coordination Note

Two workstreams have been delegated for earnings preparation:

1. Coverage Analyst (coverage-analyst): Coverage analysis for the upcoming earnings season.
2. Model Analyst (model-analyst): Financial model analysis for the upcoming earnings season.

Both workstreams are assigned to Bench Stark Enterprise. This note serves as the coordinator reference for tracking progress across both streams.
